description: On the tabletop in front are four colorful plastic cups (yellow, red, green, blue), a yellow squeeze bottle, and a small blue sponge cloth. The right hand holds the red cup near the center while the left hand reaches left to grasp the yellow bottle and brings its tip to the rim of the red cup as if dispensing cleaner, then sets the bottle back down and picks up the blue sponge, pressing and twisting it inside the red cup while the right hand steadies and slightly rotates the cup.
